subject.title: fix(canvas): reject oversized A2UI JSONL files before dispatch

question: Should file-backed Canvas A2UI input gain a new 1 MiB public limit, or should the bounded reader preserve the existing Gateway-sized payload range?
rationale: The code safely bounds reads, but choosing a substantially lower user-visible payload ceiling is a compatibility and product-policy decision not established by current docs or protocol.

options.title: Preserve current range
options.body: Use a bounded limit aligned with the canonical dispatch envelope, document it, and test accepted and rejected boundaries.

options.title: Adopt 1 MiB limit
options.body: Explicitly approve 1 MiB as the Canvas contract and update user documentation and upgrade-facing behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause the cap
options.body: Keep the PR open until a Canvas-specific payload contract is defined and real behavior proof is supplied.

recommendation.title: Preserve current range
recommendation.body: Use a bounded limit aligned with the canonical dispatch envelope, document it, and test accepted and rejected boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent focused Canvas runtime work makes this the best available routing candidate for the limit decision.
